BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released the notification for the recruitment of Bihar Police Company Commander Posts on the official website of the Bihar Police BPSSC. As per the notification, Online application process for BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Recruitment 2026 will start From 10 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 10 October 2026. There is a total of 65 vacancies has been issued. Candidates must check the details for BPSSC Bihar Police Company Commander Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2026
  • Last Date : 10 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
